gaps.sentence: ___ did he apologise, but he also refunded the full amount.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only did he..., but he also...' is the correlative pattern with inversion.

gaps.sentence: The flat is spacious and well located; ___, the rent is surprisingly low.
gaps.explanation: 'Moreover' adds another supporting point in the same direction.

gaps.sentence: ___ his age, he still plays football every week.
gaps.explanation: 'Despite his age' — noun phrase after despite.

gaps.sentence: I enjoyed the film; the ending was weak, ___.
gaps.explanation: 'Though' can come at the end of a sentence as a casual contrast marker; the others cannot.

gaps.sentence: He talks ___ he owned the place.
gaps.explanation: 'As if/though + past' describes behaviour contrary to fact (he doesn't own it).

gaps.sentence: We took the coast road ___ the motorway to enjoy the views.
gaps.explanation: 'Instead of + noun' marks the rejected alternative.

gaps.sentence: ___ had we sat down than the phone rang.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner' pairs with 'than'; hardly/scarcely pair with 'when'.

gaps.sentence: ___ the north coast is rocky, the southern beaches are soft golden sand.
gaps.explanation: 'While' can contrast two clauses in a single sentence.
